data.offering_description: Provides health savings account custody, administration and benefits platforms to employers, health plans and their employees, earning fees on accounts, transactions and services across the US.

data.primary_products: health savings accounts; health reimbursement accounts; benefits payment cards; benefits management platform

data.primary_services: account administration; COBRA administration; investment management for accounts; benefits enrollment support

data.customer_segment: B2B: employers, health plans, benefits brokers and consultants; B2C: individual employees and members holding health savings accounts

data.revenue_model: transaction or usage fees: fees per card transaction and account activity; service fees: account administration and benefits platform fees paid by employers; commissions or management fees: fees on invested account balances; interest or premiums: interest income on account cash balances

data.value_chain_position: financial intermediary: holds and custodies health savings account assets for account holders; service provider: administers accounts and benefits for employers and health plans; software / platform: benefits platform used by employers and members, sold to employers and plans

data.geography_served: US national: Serves employers and members across all US states

data.specialization: related lines: health savings accounts, health reimbursement accounts, COBRA administration, benefits payment cards

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: sales teams selling to large national employers; partners / resellers: health plans, benefits brokers and consultants that refer employers; online: online member portal and mobile app for account holders

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: IRS rules for HSAs, ERISA, HIPAA privacy and state trust company oversight

data.offering_description: Provides custodial services and platforms for health savings accounts (HSAs), plus FSA, HRA, COBRA and commuter benefit administration. Serves employers, health plans, brokers and individual account holders. Earns money from custodial, interchange and service fees, and offers investment options to members.

data.primary_products: health savings accounts; investment platform for HSA balances; benefits debit cards

data.primary_services: HSA custodial services; consumer-directed benefit administration (FSA, HRA, COBRA, commuter); member education and support

data.customer_segment: B2B: employers, health plans, benefits brokers and benefit administrators; B2C: individual account holders and employees using HSAs

data.end_markets: healthcare benefits; employee benefits administration; financial services; retirement and savings

data.revenue_model: service fees: monthly account and administration fees from employers, plans and members; transaction or usage fees: interchange fees on card purchases; interest or premiums: custodial cash balances placed with banks and interest on deposits; commissions or management fees: investment fees on member HSA investments

data.value_chain_position: financial intermediary: HSA custodian holding member funds, working with employers, health plans and partner banks; service provider: administers consumer-directed benefits for employers and plans

data.geography_served: US national: Members and employers across the United States

data.specialization: related lines: HSA custody, FSA/HRA, COBRA and commuter benefit administration, and investments

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: sales to employers and benefit consultants; partners / resellers: health plans and benefits partners offering HSAs to their clients; online: member enrollment through online portal and mobile app

data.regulatory_exposure: high: HSA non-bank custodian regulated by IRS and Treasury rules, also ERISA, DOL, HIPAA and CFPB oversight
